mapper.select: SELECT fund_cd , fund_nm , re_seolj_ymd , fst_seolj_ymd , haeji_ymd FROM szm0ia t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, #{tymd} + 1) > #{tymd} AND type_gb IN ('5','6') ORDER BY fund_cd

SELECT t1.CORP_GR , t1.YMD AS ymd , t1.type_gb , t1.FUND_CD , CASE WHEN t1.jm_gr='1' THEN '채권' WHEN t1.jm_gr='3' THEN '주식' END AS gubun , CASE t1.danc_gb WHEN 'A' THEN '거래소' WHEN 'C' THEN '코스닥' WHEN 'D' THEN '코넥스' WHEN 'B' THEN '비상장' END AS danc_gb , t1.jm_gr , t1.jm_cd , t1.jm_nm , t1.buy_date , t1.chasu , t1.type_trench , t1.bs_type , NVL(t1.aekm,0) AS venture_total , NVL(t1.sise,0) AS sise , NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) AS siga_aek , NVL(t1.aekm,0) - NVL(t1.vc_old,0) AS venture_new , t1.vc_old , t1.vc_old_dt AS vc_old_dt , NVL(uh.sun_jasan_aek,0) AS NAV , NVL(uh.real_jasan_aek,0) AS total_nav , CASE WHEN uh.real_jasan_aek=0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) * (1 - NVL(vc_old,0) / NVL(t1.aekm,0)) * 100 / (uh.real_jasan_aek) END AS venture_new_per , CASE WHEN uh.real_jasan_aek=0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) * NVL(vc_old,0) / NVL(t1.aekm,0) * 100 / (uh.real_jasan_aek) END AS venture_old_per , CASE WHEN uh.real_jasan_aek=0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(t1.siga_aek,0) * 100 / (uh.real_jasan_aek) END AS venture_total_per , jb.venture_start AS venture_start , jb.venture_end AS venture_end FROM UZM0UI t1 JOIN UZM0UH uh ON uh.corp_gr = t1.CORP_GR AND uh.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND uh.ymd = t1.ymd LEFT JOIN SJX0JB jb ON jb.balh_co = t1.balh_co WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd = #{fundCd} AND t1.ymd BETWEEN #{fymd} AND #{tymd} AND NVL(t1.aekm,0) > 0 ORDER BY t1.ymd ASC, t1.jm_cd ASC
